停掉 pygbag 调试。这条路已经证明走不通——WASM 运行时加载失败是 pygbag 的已知问题，不是我们能修的。

**新方案：纯 JS + Canvas 重写马里奥**

目标：一个自包含的 `index.html`，零外部依赖，浏览器直接打开就能玩。

要求：
1. 纯 JavaScript + HTML5 Canvas，不用任何框架/CDN
2. 完整游戏循环：开始画面 → 游戏中 → 通关/死亡
3. 马里奥核心玩法：左右移动、跳跃、重力、碰撞检测
4. 至少包含：地面、平台、砖块、金币、敌人（可踩扁）、旗杆
5. 像素风格，用代码绘制（不用外部图片）
6. 键盘控制：← → 移动，空格/↑ 跳跃
7. 分数显示、生命值、关卡进度
8. 单文件，控制在 50KB 以内

参考现有 Python 源码的游戏逻辑（/root/.nanobot/workspace/mario_game/*.py），但完全用 JS 重写，不要试图移植。

写完后：
1. 保存到 /root/.nanobot/workspace/mario_game/build/web/mario.html
2. 用 python3 -m http.server 9878 在 build/web/ 目录启动服务
3. 用 cloudflared tunnel --url localhost:9878 部署

这是最终方案，不再换方向。

// ── Game Objects ──────────────────────────────────
class Mario{
  constructor(x,y){

    this.vx=0;this.vy=0;this.onGround=false;

  }
  update(){
    if(!this.alive||this.win)return;

    this.x+=this.vx;this.collideX();
    this.y+=this.vy;this.onGround=false;this.collideY();
    if(this.y>H+100)this.die();

    if(this.invincible>0)this.invincible--;
  }
  collideX(){
    for(let b of blocks){
      let r=b.getRect();
      if(this.x<r.x+r.w&&this.x+this.w>r.x&&this.y<r.y+r.h&&this.y+this.h>r.y){
        if(this.vx>0)this.x=r.x-this.w;

  }
  collideY(){
    for(let b of blocks){
      let r=b.getRect();
      if(this.x<r.x+r.w&&this.x+this.w>r.x&&this.y<r.y+r.h&&this.y+this.h>r.y){
        if(this.vy>0){this.y=r.y-this.h;this.vy=0;this.onGround=true}
        else if(this.vy<0){this.y=r.y+r.h;this.vy=0}

  }
  die(){

  }
  respawn(){this.x=this.spawnX;this.y=this.spawnY;this.vx=0;this.vy=0;this.alive=true;this.onGround=false;this.invincible=90;this.win=false}
  getRect(){return{x:this.x,y:this.y,w:this.w,h:this.h}}
  draw(){
    if(!this.alive)return;

    ctx.fillStyle=RED;ctx.fillRect(x+4,y,this.w-8,this.h/4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffc896';ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+this.h/4,this.w-8,this.h/4);
    let ex=this.facing?x+this.w-12:x+8;
    ctx.fillStyle=BLACK;ctx.fillRect(ex,y+this.h/4+2,3,3);

}

class Block{
  constructor(x,y,type){
    this.x=x;this.y=y;this.w=TILE;this.h=TILE;
    this.type=type;this.hit=false;this.bounce=0;
  }
  getRect(){return{x:this.x,y:this.y+this.bounce,w:this.w,h:this.h}}
  update(){if(this.bounce<0)this.bounce+=2;if(this.bounce>0)this.bounce=0}
  hitBlock(){
    if(this.type==='question'&&!this.hit){this.hit=true;this.bounce=-8;return'coin'}
    if(this.type==='brick'&&!this.hit){this.hit=true;this.bounce=-8;return'break'}
    return null;
  }
  draw(){
    let x=this.x-cam.x,y=this.y+this.bounce;
    if(this.type==='ground'){
      ctx.fillStyle=BROWN;ctx.fillRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);

    }else if(this.type==='brick'){
      let c=this.hit?'#643c1e':BRICK;
      ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle=DBROWN;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle=DBROWN;ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+this.w/2,y);ctx.lineTo(x+this.w/2,y+this.h/2);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y+this.h/2);ctx.lineTo(x+this.w,y+this.h/2);ctx.stroke();

      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+3*this.w/4,y+this.h/2);ctx.lineTo(x+3*this.w/4,y+this.h);ctx.stroke();
    }else if(this.type==='question'){
      let c=this.hit?'#78643c':QCOLOR;
      ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle=DBROWN;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
      if(!this.hit){ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;ctx.font='bold 22px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('?',x+this.w/2,y+this.h/2)}
    }else if(this.type==='pipe'){
      ctx.fillStyle=PIPE;ctx.fillRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle=PIPE_DARK;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
      ctx.fillStyle='#64dc64';ctx.fillRect(x+4,y,8,this.h);
    }
  }
}

class Coin{
  constructor(x,y){this.x=x;this.y=y;this.w=20;this.h=24;this.collected=false;this.frame=0}
  update(){this.frame++}
  getRect(){return{x:this.x,y:this.y,w:this.w,h:this.h}}
  draw(){
    if(this.collected)return;
    let x=this.x-cam.x,y=this.y;
    let sq=.4+Math.abs(Math.sin(this.frame*.1))*.6;
    let cw=this.w*sq,cx=x+(this.w-cw)/2;
    ctx.fillStyle=YELLOW;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx+cw/2,y+this.h/2,cw/2,this.h/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd700';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx+cw/2-1,y+this.h/2-1,Math.max((cw-4)/2,1),(this.h-4)/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }
}

class Goomba{
  constructor(x,y){
    this.x=x;this.y=y;this.w=30;this.h=30;
    this.startX=x;this.vx=-1.5;this.vy=0;
    this.alive=true;this.frame=0;this.squishTimer=0;
  }
  update(){
    if(!this.alive){this.squishTimer--;return}
    this.vy+=GRAVITY;if(this.vy>10)this.vy=10;
    this.x+=this.vx;this.y+=this.vy;
    if(Math.abs(this.x-this.startX)>120)this.vx=-this.vx;
    let r=this.getRect();
    for(let b of blocks){
      let s=b.getRect();
      if(r.x<s.x+s.w&&r.x+r.w>s.x&&r.y<s.y+s.h&&r.y+r.h>s.y){
        if(this.vy>0){this.y=s.y-this.h;this.vy=0}
        else if(this.vx>0){this.x=s.x-this.w;this.vx=-this.vx}
        else if(this.vx<0){this.x=s.x+s.w;this.vx=-this.vx}
      }
    }
    if(this.y>H+100)this.alive=false;
    this.frame++;
  }
  squish(){this.alive=false;this.squishTimer=20;this.h=10}
  getRect(){return{x:this.x,y:this.y,w:this.w,h:this.h}}
  draw(){
    if(this.squishTimer<=0&&!this.alive)return;
    let x=this.x-cam.x,y=this.y;
    if(this.alive){
      ctx.fillStyle=ENEMY;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+this.w/2,y+this.h/3,this.w/2,this.h/3,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      let off=this.frame%2===0?1:-1;
      ctx.fillStyle=BLACK;ctx.fillRect(x+2+off,y+this.h*2/3,this.w/3,this.h/3);
      ctx.fillRect(x+this.w-this.w/3-2-off,y+this.h*2/3,this.w/3,this.h/3);
      ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+this.w/3,y+this.h/3,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+2*this.w/3,y+this.h/3,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle=BLACK;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+this.w/3+1,y+this.h/3,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+2*this.w/3+1,y+this.h/3,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }else{
      ctx.fillStyle='#963232';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+this.w/2,y+this.h/2,this.w/2,this.h/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

class Flag{
  constructor(x,y){this.x=x;this.y=y;this.w=10;this.h=TILE*4;this.reached=false}
  getRect(){return{x:this.x,y:this.y,w:this.w+30,h:this.h}}
  draw(){
    let x=this.x-cam.x,y=this.y;
    ctx.fillStyle=POLE;ctx.fillRect(x,y,this.w,this.h);
    let fy=y+10;let c=this.reached?'#32ff32':'#ff3232';
    ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+this.w,fy);ctx.lineTo(x+this.w+30,fy+15);ctx.lineTo(x+this.w,fy+30);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=YELLOW;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+this.w/2,y,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }
}

class Particle{
  constructor(x,y,color,vx,vy,life){
    this.x=x;this.y=y;this.color=color;
    this.vx=vx!==undefined?vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*6;
    this.vy=vy!==undefined?vy:-1-Math.random()*4;
    this.life=life||30;this.max=this.life;
  }
  update(){this.x+=this.vx;this.y+=this.vy;this.vy+=0.15;this.life--}
  draw(){
    if(this.life<=0)return;
    let a=this.life/this.max,s=Math.max(1,3*a);
    ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.fillStyle=this.color;
    ctx.fillRect(this.x-cam.x,this.y,s,s);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
}
class ScorePopup{
  constructor(x,y,text,color){this.x=x;this.y=y;this.text=text;this.color=color||WHITE;this.life=40}
  update(){this.y--;this.life--}
  draw(){
    if(this.life<=0)return;

    ctx.fillStyle=this.color;ctx.font='bold 16px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';

}

// ── Camera ──────────────────────────────────────────
class Camera{
  constructor(lw){this.x=0;this.lw=lw}
  update(tx){this.x=tx-W/3;this.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(this.x,this.lw-W))}
}

// ── Objects ─────────────────────────────────────────
let player,blocks,coins,enemies,flag,cam,particles,popups,currentLevel=0,dt=0,wt=0;

function parseLevel(data){
  let bl=[],co=[],en=[],fl=null,st={x:TILE*2,y:TILE*12};
  for(let ri=0;ri<data.length;ri++)
    for(let ci=0;ci<data[ri].length;ci++){
      let ch=data[ri][ci],x=ci*TILE,y=ri*TILE;
      if(ch==='G')bl.push(new Block(x,y,'ground'));
      else if(ch==='B')bl.push(new Block(x,y,'brick'));
      else if(ch==='?')bl.push(new Block(x,y,'question'));
      else if(ch==='P')bl.push(new Block(x,y,'pipe'));
      else if(ch==='C')co.push(new Coin(x+10,y+8));
      else if(ch==='E')en.push(new Goomba(x,y));
      else if(ch==='F')fl=new Flag(x,y);
    }
  return{bl,co,en,fl,st};
}

function loadLevel(idx){
  let data=LEVELS[idx%LEVELS.length];
  let p=parseLevel(data);
  let pl=new Mario(p.st.x,p.st.y);
  let ca=new Camera(data[0].length*TILE);
  return{player:pl,blocks:p.bl,coins:p.co,enemies:p.en,flag:p.fl,cam:ca,particles:[],popups:[]};
}

function resetGame(){
  let l=loadLevel(currentLevel);
  player=l.player;blocks=l.blocks;coins=l.coins;enemies=l.enemies;
  flag=l.flag;cam=l.cam;particles=l.particles;popups=l.popups;
  dt=0;wt=0;
}

resetGame();

// ── Game Loop ──────────────────────────────────────
function update(){
  if(!player.alive){
    dt++;
    if(dt>90){
      if(player.lives<=0){currentLevel=0;resetGame()}
      else player.respawn();
      dt=0;
    }
  }else if(player.win){
    wt++;
    if(wt>120){currentLevel++;let l=loadLevel(currentLevel);player=l.player;blocks=l.blocks;coins=l.coins;enemies=l.enemies;flag=l.flag;cam=l.cam;particles=l.particles;popups=l.popups;wt=0}
  }else{
    let solids=blocks.map(b=>b.getRect());
    player.update();
    cam.update(player.x);
    enemies.forEach(e=>e.update());
    coins.forEach(c=>c.update());
    blocks.forEach(b=>b.update());

    // collisions
    let pr=player.getRect();
    coins.forEach(c=>{
      if(!c.collected){
        let cr=c.getRect();
        if(pr.x<cr.x+cr.w&&pr.x+pr.w>cr.x&&pr.y<cr.y+cr.h&&pr.y+pr.h>cr.y){
          c.collected=true;player.coins++;player.score+=100;
          popups.push(new ScorePopup(c.x,c.y,'+100',YELLOW));
          for(let i=0;i<5;i++)particles.push(new Particle(c.x+10,c.y+10,YELLOW));
        }
      }
    });
    enemies.forEach(e=>{
      if(!e.alive)return;
      let er=e.getRect();
      if(pr.x<er.x+er.w&&pr.x+pr.w>er.x&&pr.y<er.y+er.h&&pr.y+pr.h>er.y){
        if(player.vy>0&&player.y+player.h-er.y<15){
          e.squish();player.vy=JUMP*0.6;player.score+=200;
          popups.push(new ScorePopup(e.x,e.y,'+200',WHITE));
        }else if(player.invincible<=0){
          player.die();
        }
      }
    });
    // bump blocks from below
    if(player.vy<0){
      blocks.forEach(b=>{
        let br=b.getRect();
        if(pr.x<br.x+br.w&&pr.x+pr.w>br.x&&pr.y<br.y+br.h&&pr.y+pr.h>br.y&&player.y>br.y){
          let r=b.hitBlock();
          if(r==='coin'){player.coins++;player.score+=100;popups.push(new ScorePopup(b.x,b.y-20,'+100',YELLOW));for(let i=0;i<3;i++)particles.push(new Particle(b.x+TILE/2,b.y,YELLOW,undefined,undefined,20))}
          else if(r==='break'){player.score+=50;for(let i=0;i<8;i++)particles.push(new Particle(b.x+TILE/2,b.y+TILE/2,BRICK,undefined,undefined,25))}
        }
      });
    }
    // flag
    if(flag&&!flag.reached){
      let fr=flag.getRect();
      if(pr.x<fr.x+fr.w&&pr.x+pr.w>fr.x&&pr.y<fr.y+fr.h&&pr.y+pr.h>fr.y){
        flag.reached=true;player.win=true;player.score+=1000;
        popups.push(new ScorePopup(flag.x,flag.y,'+1000','#32ff32'));
      }
    }
    particles.forEach(p=>p.update());particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
    popups.forEach(p=>p.update());popups=popups.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.fillStyle=SKY;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // clouds
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    let cx=(i*200-cam.x*.3)%(W+200)-100,cy=40+i*30;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,40,15,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx+20,cy-15,30,15,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx+40,cy,35,12,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }

  blocks.forEach(b=>b.draw());
  coins.forEach(c=>c.draw());
  enemies.forEach(e=>e.draw());
  if(flag)flag.draw();
  player.draw();
  particles.forEach(p=>p.draw());
  popups.forEach(p=>p.draw());

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;ctx.font='bold 20px Arial';ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: '+player.score,10,22);
  ctx.fillStyle=YELLOW;ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('COINS: '+player.coins,W/2,22);
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES: '+player.lives,W-10,22);
  ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.font='bold 16px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('WORLD '+(currentLevel+1)+'-1',W/2,45);

  // Game Over
  if(!player.alive&&player.lives<=0){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle=RED;ctx.font='bold 40px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-15);
    ctx.fillStyle=WHITE;ctx.font='bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press R to Restart',W/2,H/2+30);
    ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  }
  // Level Clear
  if(player.win){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#32ff32';ctx.font='bold 40px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText('LEVEL CLEAR!',W/2,H/2);
    ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  }
}

function gameLoop(){
  if(keys['KeyR']&&(!player.alive||player.win)){resetGame()}
  if(keys['Escape']){/* close handled by browser */}
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
